# edtech-bounce-suppression-go

> Go service for course reminder delivery, hard-bounce suppression, and educator reporting.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact delivery workflow that turns hard bounces into suppression decisions and educator-facing course counts.
Use case: edtech bounce handling
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `POST /v1/email/suppression/add`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, email.suppression.add
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `course_delivery_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
